questions.text_en: Is the baby feeding less than usual?

questions.text_en: Is the baby very sleepy or hard to wake?

questions.text_hi: क्या माँ को धुंधला दिख रहा है?

questions.text_en: Has the mother had fits?
questions.text_hi: क्या माँ को दौरे पड़े हैं?

questions.text_en: Is the baby moving less than usual?

questions.threshold_note: Job Aid refer threshold is fever more than 102 F. App asks plain fever, no thermometer.

questions.text_en: Is there foul-smelling discharge?

questions.text_en: Is the baby's chest drawing in with each breath?
